lines.en: Welcome to my apartment, Samir! Oh, and I'd rather you didn't smoke inside, if you don't mind. My sister has asthma.
lines.pt: Bem-vindo ao meu apartamento, Samir! Ah, e eu preferiria que você não fumasse aqui dentro, se não se importar. Minha irmã tem asma.

lines.en: Of course, sorry! I didn't know she was staying with you, and I don't want to annoy anyone. Can I use the balcony instead?
lines.pt: Claro, desculpe! Não sabia que ela estava hospedada com você, e não quero incomodar ninguém. Posso usar a varanda?

lines.en: The balcony's fine, thanks. She's only here for a week while her apartment gets painted, so I'm keeping the smell outside.
lines.pt: A varanda está ótima, obrigada. Ela só fica uma semana enquanto o apartamento dela é pintado, então estou mantendo o cheiro lá fora.

lines.en: That makes sense. Honestly, I'd rather not smoke at all. I've been trying to quit since January, but it's harder than I expected.
lines.pt: Faz sentido. Sinceramente, preferiria nem fumar. Estou tentando parar desde janeiro, mas é mais difícil do que eu esperava.

lines.en: I had no idea! Good for you. Do you want coffee or tea? I've got mint tea, if you need something calming.
lines.pt: Eu não fazia ideia! Parabéns. Quer café ou chá? Tenho chá de menta, se precisar de algo calmante.

lines.en: Coffee, please, strong and black. I need it to wake up, since I barely slept last night. Work has been stressful.
lines.pt: Café, por favor, forte e puro. Preciso dele para acordar, porque mal dormi ontem à noite. O trabalho tem sido estressante.

lines.en: Strong and black, coming up. By the way, would you rather we ate here, or went to the restaurant downstairs?
lines.pt: Forte e puro, saindo. A propósito, você prefere que a gente coma aqui ou vá ao restaurante lá embaixo?

lines.en: Let's eat here, if that's okay. Restaurants in this neighborhood are pricey, and my paycheck doesn't arrive until Friday.
lines.pt: Vamos comer aqui, se não tiver problema. Os restaurantes deste bairro são caros, e meu pagamento só cai na sexta.

lines.en: Perfect, I enjoy cooking anyway. I'm making pasta with spinach and garlic, and there's a big salad to go with it.
lines.pt: Perfeito, eu gosto de cozinhar mesmo. Vou fazer macarrão com espinafre e alho, e tem uma salada grande para acompanhar isso.

lines.en: Sounds wonderful. Just don't make too much, though. I had a late lunch with my boss, and I'm still pretty full.
lines.pt: Parece ótimo. Só não faça demais, tá? Almocei tarde com meu chefe e ainda estou bem cheio.

lines.en: No problem. We can save the leftovers for tomorrow, and you can take some home if you'd like.
lines.pt: Sem problema. Podemos guardar as sobras para amanhã, e você pode levar um pouco para casa se quiser.

compare.ask: I would rather you waited outside.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “eu preferia que você não fumasse” com o subjuntivo, e fica muito natural.
compare.tip: Diga: “I would rather you waited outside.”
compare.us: Em inglês, depois de would rather + pessoa, use o passado simples: I would rather you did not smoke. O verbo está no passado, mas fala do presente ou do futuro.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: I would rather you waited outside.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

facts.label: Preferências sobre os outros
facts.sub: Diga I would rather you did not smoke here.

facts.label: Pedido educado
facts.sub: Para dizer o que você quer que o outro faça: I would rather you did not smoke here. O verbo fica no passado, mas fala do presente ou do futuro.

facts.label: Sua própria escolha
facts.sub: Para você mesmo, o verbo fica na base, sem to: I would rather go out. Para negativo: I would rather not stay. Compare duas opções com than.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: I would rather you did not smoke is a polite request.
items.why: It is gentle and common among friends.

items.s: After would rather you, the verb goes in the past form.
items.why: I would rather you left, not leave.

items.s: Would rather you did means I want you to do it in the past.
items.why: The past form talks about now or the future.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: I would rather you did not smoke is a polite request. → Verdadeiro (It is gentle and common among friends.)
After would rather you, the verb goes in the past form. → Verdadeiro (I would rather you left, not leave.)
Would rather you did means I want you to do it in the past. → Falso (The past form talks about now or the future.)

paragraphs: It is Friday evening in Chicago. Luisa visits Blake for the first time. His new apartment is small but warm. A pack of cigarettes is in her bag. Blake has one polite request. He asks it with would rather.

“Welcome to the apartment, Luisa! Oh, and I would rather you did not smoke inside, if you do not mind.” says Blake. “Of course, sorry. I did not know. I would rather go out to the balcony than annoy anybody. Is that okay?” says Luisa. “The balcony is fine, thanks. My sister has asthma and she is staying with me, so I keep the smell outside.” says Blake.
